purpose: Reuse the existing Evan Job Stage V4 contractor application as the operational shell for ABC Roofing production-readiness governance without rewriting proven financial/closeout behavior.
architectureLaw: Evan V4 remains the job/record/persistence/management shell. ABC Roofing adds production-readiness record classes and a separate governance evaluator. Existing financial and closeout calculations are not redefined by the roofing module.

classifications.component: Job identity and editable job records
classifications.reason: Existing job identity, create/edit/archive/remove lifecycle is domain-compatible.
Existing jobs/files/records stores already support persistent per-job evidence.
Existing backup V2 preserves jobs, records and files and is useful for portable qualification specimens.
Existing local file attachment mechanism can hold supporting documents without creating a new storage system.
Keep Active Jobs, Needs Attention and job workspace; add production-readiness state and blockers without removing financial metrics.
Preserve Done / Still needed / Needs review and Needs attention translation; map governance states to manager-facing language rather than exposing only technical state names.
Existing structured record editor is reusable but record vocabulary must include production-readiness evidence classes.
Contract, Change Order, Customer Invoice, Customer Payment, Subcontractor Bill, Supplier Bill, Insurance Record and Other remain valid.
Required to represent the frozen roofing operating corridor and later QC progression.
Approved, invoiced, paid, unsigned changes, trade payables and closeout issues remain an independent proven concern.
Must implement the frozen readiness contract separately from financial calculation logic.
Per-job readiness result must expose overall state, requirement states, blockers, correspondence findings and permitted next moves.
Existing back-half job closeout remains useful and should not be conflated with production readiness.
Dedicated manager-facing view for Inspection → Scope → Authorization → Permit → Materials → Production Slot qualification.
Existing financial fixture must continue passing after roofing extension.
Evaluator development uses non-blind fixtures separate from the frozen ABC qualification specimen.
Must not be encoded into contract, evaluator logic or development fixtures before evaluator freeze.

ESTABLISHED.managerAction: Production may proceed subject to human authorization.

NEGATED.managerAction: Resolve the failed or revoked requirement before production.

UNPROVEN.managerAction: Obtain or establish the missing evidence before production.

CONFLICTING.managerAction: Reconcile incompatible job/scope/version evidence before production.

protectedBehaviors: Existing Evan financial calculations remain unchanged.
Existing Evan record classes remain accepted.
Existing job persistence and backup/restore remain functional.
Existing demo/real-job separation remains functional unless separately changed.
Existing closeout semantics are not redefined as production-readiness semantics.
A CRM/dashboard stage or manual status does not override governance qualification.
Human authority is preserved; evaluator output qualifies evidence and permitted progression only.
implementationSequence: Add separate roofing readiness evaluator against the frozen contract.
Add non-blind roofing development fixtures and verify evaluator behavior.
Run existing Evan V4 test-kitchen regression unchanged.
Extend dashboard with Production Readiness view and management-facing blockers.
Only then expose evaluator to frozen ABC blind specimen.
stopCondition: No application mutation beyond the frozen crosswalk until the implementation delta is explicitly bound and existing Evan V4 regression behavior is preserved.
